label: Divergent pivot fires only on a clean STOP whose reasonDetail is composite_converged or all_questions_answered AND convergence_mode == 'divergent'; the stop must first survive early returns including stopPolicy 'max-iterations' (CONTINUE before any candidate forms) and convergenceMode 'off'. This packet's own config disables the pivot path twice over.

CORRECTS GENERATION 1: an accepted divergent pivot buys min(maxIterations - triggerIteration, remaining pivot budget), not ~1 iteration. The pivot never adds questions so all_questions_answered re-fires at every later stop, each consuming one of maxPivots:3 lifetime pivots; the maxIterations cap at convergence.cjs:1115 is evaluated before the branch and is excluded from pivoting. '~1 iteration' holds only when the trigger lands at maxIterations-1.

Under execution_mode auto, gate_divergent_pivot_choice is skipped (applies_to: confirm) so a Council-selected candidate is auto-adopted with no operator; a failed pivot fails closed to synthesis since the override gate is also confirm-only and conditioned on insufficient_endorsement.

Yield's binding limit is council agreement and the lifetime maxCouncilSeatOutputs:9 seat cap (three pivots x three seats exactly saturate it; a resumed pivot burns budget), not candidate starvation: keyFindings.slice(-3) cross-check seeds regenerate from the newest findings every stop.

D1 honest fix: produce quality_class inside the graph layer at the single ingest choke point (upsert.cjs node-validation loop) by deriving it deterministically from verifiable SOURCE attributes (path top-level segment + file type; URL host class), from a frozen vocabulary const beside SAFE_METADATA_KEYS, while stripping/overwriting any leaf-supplied value; alternative is deriving at query time in coverage-graph-signals.ts and deleting the field. Residual gaming is bounded because cited sources are real paths/URLs SOURCE_TAGS validation resolves.
maxIterationsReached is terminal and outranks every veto and the divergent-pivot branch; it is evaluated before stop-candidate selection and is on the pivot exclusion list.
minRemainingIterations:1 is nearly dead code: remainingIterations==0 implies iterationCount>=maxIterations, which the cap catches before prepare can run.
Sub-question for a later iteration: whether maxCouncilSeatOutputs should be per-pivot rather than lifetime, since a partial/resumed pivot silently shrinks the effective pivot count below maxPivots:3.
